description: The AI company's six-stage standard operating pipeline – click a stage to see the tasks in it

stages.receive: The Owner submits a request; the AI CEO receives it and clarifies goals, scope and priority.
stages.plan: The AI CEO drafts the master plan, splits it into items, estimates budget and sends it to the Owner for approval.
stages.assign: The AI Project Manager breaks the plan into concrete tasks and assigns them to specialists in each department.
stages.execute: AI Specialists carry out the work (research, content, ads, data…) and update progress continuously.
stages.review: The AI QA Reviewer checks quality; anything below standard goes back for revision.
stages.report: The AI COO consolidates results, KPIs and optimisation proposals into a report for the Owner.

rules.title: Governance Rules
rules.description: A fixed chain of responsibility for every Owner request

items.approvalFirst: No plan or budget is executed before the Owner has decided.
items.qaGate: Every deliverable passes quality review before publishing or reporting.
items.realtime: Progress, agent status and the activity log sync in real time on every screen.
